detached_structure.evidence: A small gray-roofed outbuilding or shed sits southeast of the main house at the lower center of the lot, with a smaller shed-like object near the rear fence.

signals.notes: The central house has a large gray hip-style roof with a rear patio or deck on the east side, and dense mature trees border the west side and part of the yard, so a field rep may have limited view of the property from above.
